privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How ClutchD handles information when you visit the site or sign up for early access.

body: This policy explains how the ClutchD site handles information when you visit it or sign up for early access.

When you enter your email address to request early access, we receive it through our form provider at the contact address clutchd04dsvs@gmail.com. We use it solely to contact you about the ClutchD Coimbatore launch. We do not share, sell, or rent your email address to anyone.
Your email is stored with our form provider and checked by our team.
You can ask us to remove it at any time by emailing clutchd04dsvs@gmail.com.
We do not send marketing newsletters beyond launch-related updates.

The site uses GoatCounter, a cookie-free, privacy-friendly analytics tool, to count page views and measure general traffic. GoatCounter does not use cookies and does not collect personal data such as names, email addresses, or IP-identifying information.
Your browser may store two small flags locally: your early-access dedupe list and the dismissal state of our privacy notice. These never leave your device.
Questions about this policy or your data? Email clutchd04dsvs@gmail.com.
You can ask what data we hold about you, correct it, or have it deleted. Email clutchd04dsvs@gmail.com with the subject Erasure Request and we will confirm removal.
This page's Tamil translation is informational; the English version governs in any dispute.
Early-access emails are kept until the launch rollout completes or until you ask for removal, whichever comes first. Analytics contain no personal data and need no retention schedule.

ClutchD is built for India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act: consent before collection, purpose-limited use, and reasonable safeguards. Full compliance documentation ships with the public launch; until then this page describes current practice.

Payments are processed by Stripe and Razorpay; push notifications use Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM); crash monitoring uses Sentry. Each processes only the data its job needs, under its own published policy.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: The terms that apply when you use the ClutchD site or sign up for early access.

body: The ClutchD site introduces the ClutchD platform and collects early-access interest. Everything shown — features, prices, stats, testimonials, timelines — is an illustrative preview of the planned service and does not constitute an offer, contract, or guarantee of availability, pricing, or service levels.
Submitting your email requests early access to the ClutchD Coimbatore rollout. It does not guarantee access, timing, or pricing. We may contact you at the address you provide.
Do not submit false, abusive, or automated form submissions.
Do not attempt to disrupt, scrape, or probe the site.
Do not reuse ClutchD content, marks, or visuals without permission.
The site is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We may change, suspend, or remove the site or the early-access program at any time.
Questions about these terms? Email clutchd04dsvs@gmail.com.
Provide accurate location and vehicle details when requesting help.
Treat providers respectfully; abuse or threats end the job and may end your access.
Pay for approved work through the platform; off-platform settlements lose receipt protection.

ClutchD connects you with independent verified providers; roadside work carries real-world risk. To the extent permitted by law, ClutchD is not liable for indirect or consequential losses from a job. TODO(swap): jurisdiction-specific caps to be set by counsel before public launch.
We may suspend or end access for misuse, fraud, or safety concerns. You may stop using the service at any time and request data erasure under the Privacy Policy.
